Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file '04_agentic_guardrails.md' (1-based global rule indices 41–50).

Rules in this chunk:
41. A call to apply a goodwill credit with an amount greater than ten thousand pence requires human approval.
42. A call to apply a goodwill credit is not permitted if the customer's recent goodwill credit total exceeds fifty thousand pence.
43. A call to apply any refund or goodwill credit is not permitted if the affected account has any active restriction of type SANCTIONS_BLOCK.
44. A call to apply any refund or goodwill credit is not permitted if the affected account has any active restriction of type COURT_ORDER.
45. A call to apply a refund of any type where the affected customer has a vulnerable flag set to true requires that a consumer duty assessment exists for the current interaction.
46. A call to apply a fee reversal requires that the referenced transaction has a positive amount and is classified as a fee.
47. A call to apply a fee reversal is not permitted if the referenced transaction's fee already reversed flag is set to true.
48. A call to initiate a dispute requires that the referenced transaction exists.
49. A call to initiate a dispute requires that the referenced transaction has status POSTED.
50. A call to initiate a dispute requires that no other open dispute exists for the same transaction.
